title: Signal & Noise provenance ledger
description: Append-only provenance ledger for the notes and pillars at juanlentino.com. Every record is a signed (Ed25519), hash-anchored commit for one version of one document, with a detached OpenTimestamps proof against the Bitcoin blockchain. Each release is a monthly snapshot of the whole ledger; verify any record with `node verify.mjs <note_uid>`.
